name: InfiniteMenu-TS-TW
title: Infinite Menu
description: Colour photos sit as circular discs sprinkled over a spinning 3D sphere. Dragging rotates the ball; when it settles, one disc faces front with a large title, a short caption and a round arrow button.
use: A portfolio wants an unusual, tactile way to browse a handful of projects.
avoid: It needs WebGL and a sized parent, and touch or keyboard users cannot drive the spin.
a11y: The canvas has no keyboard control or text alternative, and the spin and snap ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark stage holds a loose sphere of round photo discs, each a different scene, some seen edge-on as thin slivers. At rest one disc sits large and centred, with a heavy white title to its left and a two-line caption to its right.
behaves: Dragging spins the sphere, tucking discs around the back and showing slivers edge-on while the labels fade. On release the nearest disc snaps to face the viewer and the title, caption and cyan arrow slide back in.
customise: Items with an image, title, description and link plus a scale factor are props; the disc layout, colours and spin behaviour are fixed in the source.
weight: heavy: A raw WebGL2 canvas draws a sphere of textured discs on every animation frame.
